intro: I guess if we’re all trapped in here together I should try and introduce myself to everyone and gather some information.
question: Did anything seem unusual about the guests today?
interrogation: I try my best not to spy… but earlier, I overheard Daisy and Sebes arguing in the hall.
Daisy was trying to pick the lock on the master’s safe, and Sebes had offered to help pry it open as long as she split whatever was inside with him.
They couldn’t figure out how to get it open regardless, but it seems like both of them are quite desperate for money.
win: Before he can lunge at you, you fire your single silver bullet directly into his chest.
The beast falls to the floor, defeated.
lose: [NAME] falls to the ground, but their blood is human.
A terrible chill goes down your spine as a monstrous howl echoes from the hallway behind you.
You chose the wrong suspect, leaving the real monster alive… (you lose)

day1: I’m Daisy.
I only snuck into this mansion to explore, and now we’re all stuck here because of this stupid snowstorm.
I don’t know any of these people, please stop bothering me unless you know a way to get out of here.
day2: I didn’t do it!
Yes, I was trying to figure out how to get something out of this situation, but I wouldn't kill a sweet old man!
You have to believe me!
accusation: I told you already, I didn’t kill him!
I’m not a murderer, I wouldn’t even know what to do with a bunch of tools!
Please, you have to believe me!

day1: A monster hunter, eh?
The name’s Sebes Yorke.
You may have heard of me, I’m somewhat of a hunter myself.
I hear there’s a hefty bounty on this werewolf, if you want to team up and split the profits, I’m your guy.
I’m always looking to make some quick cash.
day2: A shame he’s gone.
You see though, this just proves how dangerous the beast really is!
I say the town needs to double… no, triple! the bounty on this thing.
The risk has seriously gone up.
accusation: You really think I'd dirty my hands for a few bucks when there's a huge bounty on the line?
...Although, I suppose I could collect the bounty AND pawn those antique tools.
If you're going to stand between me and my payday, hunter, I'll just have to tear you apart!

day1: You?
A hunter?
I wouldn’t believe it with that gear.
It looks like you haven’t had an upgrade in a decade.
Who designs a gun with only one chamber?
Don’t expect me to fix it for free just because we’re stuck here together.
Well?
What are you standing around for?
My name?
Percy, but it’s irrelevant to you.
If your tools need fixing, come and find me.
Not that I care if you get yourself killed or anything.
day2: Damn it… that old man didn’t deserve that.
And whoever took all his tools, for what?
That beast wouldn’t even know how to hold a clockmaker’s screwdriver correctly.
Look, just figure out who did this, alright?
Don’t make me forge a silver weapon myself and do your job for you.
accusation: I make swords and armor, not fragile little watches and clocks.
What would I even do with some clockmaker’s tweezers?
Pull the trigger if you want, I hope you’re happy when all of our blood is on your hands.

characters.identity: Head of housekeeping for the estate.
day1: Welcome to the mansion.
I am Elara, the head of housekeeping for the estate.
I guide the staff that prepare the rooms and maintain the house.
I’d prefer to stay out of the guests’ conflicts, but I do know these halls better than anyone else.
Let me know if your room needs cleaning, and I’ll get on it right away.
day2: Mr. Palmer was nothing but kind to me and the staff.
To see a guest’s life taken so violently in these halls is deeply unsettling.
Please, hunter, find the person responsible for this.
accusation: Hunter, please be reasonable… I have dedicated my life to maintaining this estate and caring for its guests.
I have no need for any more money, nor any reason to have taken the life of an innocent guest.
You are making a grave mistake.

characters.identity: Clock repairer called to the mansion.
day1: Hello there!
This weather is quite dreary, isn’t it?
Excuse my rudeness, my name is Harold, I was called here to repair the clocks around the mansion, but it looks like we’re all trapped in here for the time being.
I don’t know if my ears are playing tricks on me, but I heard there might be a werewolf of some sorts, but I’m trying to make the best of it.
Would you care for a peppermint?
day2: Poor Harold… he was just trying to do his job and ended up as dinner for some beast...
What’s this?
His bag!
It’s been completely emptied, tools all over the floor.
The tools and parts he brought along must have been expensive, they’re all missing?
The werewolf didn’t just kill him, it robbed him!
